title: Pure Rock Crawling
description:
Pure Rock Crawling is a physics based off-road simulator. Developed by one developer. 
Immerse yourself in the world of rock crawling as you drive capable off-road trucks. Featuring soft body tires physics, complex drivetrain simulation, maps made with photogrammetry, visual and mechanical customization.

Suspension customization - equip a variety of addons that affect your riding characteristics. Different suspension types, flexible tires and lift kits. All physics based providing true to life suspension articulation and tire deformation.

Visual customization - choose between many bumpers, doors, roof addons, fenders, vinyl wraps and decals. Make your ride your own and hit the trails with style.

Challenge yourself on marked trails or just roam around. Pure Rock Crawling is a free roam game that offers additional challenges in the form of completing the trails. Main focus is to provide you a playground for best rock crawling experience in a physics based simulation of suspension and tires.

Explore variety of maps, take on challenges and have fun rock crawling !
description_short: Pure Rock Crawling is a physics based off-road simulator. Featuring soft body tires, suspension customization that affects your handling, true to life drivetrain simulation and visual addons. Explore a variety of trails in free roam with multiple challenges.
